stories.title: Burnham imposes West Bank sanctions, says UK will 'act in support of our values'
stories.summary: Andy Burnham's Government announced sanctions against Israel relating to West Bank settlements. The move drew Labour support but fury from Israel and Tory criticism.

stories.title: Burnham faces first PMQs — pressed on borrowing costs and spending
stories.summary: Andy Burnham faced Kemi Badenoch at his first Prime Minister's Questions, with opposition attacks centring on borrowing and public spending plans.

stories.title: Burnham pledges 'progress' on Bristol mass transit system
stories.summary: The Prime Minister committed to making progress on a mass transit tram network for Bristol following longstanding calls from local leaders.

topics.name: Burnham Gov Intelligence
topics.description: Procurement, tech/AI, spending, vendor & priority signals

stories.title: 🤖 UK to force Apple and Google to block explicit images on children's smartphones
stories.summary: Burnham said child safety protections will be built into devices by default, requiring tech companies to verify adult users. Legislation tabled by Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy.

stories.title: 🏗️ Netcompany selected for major NHS screening modernisation — £215m contract
stories.summary: Danish technology firm Netcompany awarded a £215 million contract to modernise NHS screening systems — one of the largest recent public sector technology procurements.

stories.title: 🤖 Invention agency chair quits amid 'conflicts of interest' over Anthropic role
stories.summary: The chair of ARIA resigned after flagging concerns about conflicts of interest following a new role at AI company Anthropic, raising questions about AI governance.

stories.title: 🤖 GOV.UK Wallet opens sandbox for digital ID firms
stories.summary: The GOV.UK Wallet programme opened a new sandbox environment for private digital identity firms to test integrations, accelerating UK digital ID infrastructure rollout.

stories.title: 💰 FT: 'Growth in every postcode' — good politics, dubious economics
stories.summary: The Financial Times editorial board critiques Burnham's flagship agenda as politically astute but economically questionable, risking spreading limited resources too thinly.

topics.name: Parliament
topics.description: House of Commons, Lords, PMQs & Legislation

stories.title: First PMQs of new parliament: Badenoch presses Burnham on borrowing and spending
stories.summary: Kemi Badenoch used her first PMQs as Leader of the Opposition to attack the Government's fiscal plans, while the PM defended Labour's investment agenda.

stories.title: Commons receives Israel/West Bank sanctions statement — heated cross-party exchanges
stories.summary: Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband delivered an emergency statement on West Bank sanctions to the Commons, drawing broad Labour support and fierce Conservative opposition.

stories.title: Civil Aviation Bill gets second reading in House of Commons
stories.summary: MPs heard the second reading of the Civil Aviation Bill, one of the Government's key early legislative priorities.

stories.title: Ed Miliband announces ban on trade in goods from illegal Israeli West Bank settlements
stories.summary: The Foreign Secretary announced a trade ban in a parliamentary statement, drawing broad Labour support and a furious Israeli government response including threats to close the British consulate.

stories.title: Holborn and St Pancras by-election: Labour at risk of upset from Greens
stories.summary: An upcoming by-election in the former Keir Starmer constituency is seen as Labour's to lose, with the Green Party mounting a credible challenge on defence and energy policy.

stories.title: Labour condemns Reform's £100bn cuts plan as 'half-baked' and 'incredibly reckless'
stories.summary: Labour's party chair attacked Reform UK's economic proposals, warning that such cuts could devastate vital public services.

stories.title: Israeli FM thanks Kemi Badenoch for opposing West Bank sanctions
stories.summary: Israel's foreign minister personally thanked Kemi Badenoch and shadow foreign secretary Tom Tugendhat for their firm opposition to the UK's sanctions against West Bank settlements.

stories.title: Badenoch claims Labour's sanctions plan driven by antisemitism
stories.summary: Tory leader Badenoch wrote in the Jewish Chronicle accusing Labour of acting to 'win back Islamists', framing the sanctions as a threat to Jewish safety — a charge rejected by the Government.

stories.title: Surrey politicians including Lib Dems demand publication of legal advice on council changes
stories.summary: Liberal Democrat and Conservative politicians called for the government to publish legal advice relating to proposed Surrey council reorganisation.

stories.title: Reform UK would ban full-face coverings in public areas
stories.summary: Party leader Nigel Farage announced in the Telegraph that Reform UK would introduce a ban on face coverings in public, saying they 'undermine trust' in a free society.

stories.title: Tim Montgomerie quits Reform following suspension at party conference
stories.summary: Conservative commentator Tim Montgomerie announced his departure from Reform UK after being suspended, adding to internal tensions at the party's conference.

stories.title: Reform faces 'headwinds' as party gathers for conference — BBC
stories.summary: BBC political editor Chris Mason noted Reform UK's growing scrutiny as its prominence rises, with Farage telling the BBC the party faces a 'complainants' society' seeking to block new political forces.

stories.title: SNP defeated in dual Edinburgh by-elections — Greens and Labour take seats
stories.summary: The SNP suffered a significant double defeat in Edinburgh council by-elections, with seats taken by the Greens and Labour, increasing pressure on First Minister John Swinney.

stories.title: Swinney accuses Reform of 'inciting racial tension' over burqa ban proposal
stories.summary: First Minister John Swinney attacked a Reform UK MSP for raising the prospect of a burqa ban in Scotland, accusing them of seeking to incite racial tension.

stories.title: Nicola Sturgeon to star in Sky drama series on hypothetical Russian attack
stories.summary: Former First Minister Nicola Sturgeon will play the role of Deputy Prime Minister in 'The Wargame', a new Sky series exploring Britain's response to a Russian military attack.

stories.title: André Loranger appointed as UK's next National Statistician
stories.summary: The King, on PM Burnham's advice, appointed André Loranger — Canada's outgoing statistics chief — as the UK's National Statistician, ending over a year's vacancy at the ONS.

stories.title: Burnham chairs National Economic Council at No. 10 North in Manchester
stories.summary: The PM chaired a National Economic Council meeting at the new Manchester government hub as his administration's first budget plans came under economic scrutiny.

stories.title: Holborn and St Pancras by-election: Labour under pressure from Green Party
stories.summary: The upcoming London by-election in the former Starmer constituency is competitive, with the Greens challenging Labour on defence, energy and housing policy.

stories.title: SNP lose two Edinburgh seats in local by-elections to Greens and Labour
stories.summary: The SNP's double defeat in Edinburgh council by-elections is seen as a significant warning for Swinney's party ahead of the Holyrood cycle.

stories.title: Farage calls for referendum on abolishing the House of Lords
stories.summary: At Reform UK's conference, Nigel Farage declared his party would appoint hundreds of new peers to gain a Lords majority and called for a public referendum on abolishing the upper chamber.

stories.title: Assisted dying bill returned to Lords for further scrutiny
stories.summary: The assisted dying bill has been referred back to the House of Lords with MPs seeking additional amendments before a final vote.
